title: Whole genome sequencing reveals a decade of human adenovirus B114 circulation in England
abstract: Background Human Mastadenovirus B (HAdV-B) causes ocular and respiratory infections and is capable of causing outbreaks in healthcare settings. HAdV-B114, a recombinant genotype only formally recognised in 2023, has been reported predominantly from Germany, the USA, China and Japan; genomic data from UK clinical settings remain limited. This study analysed 68 HAdV-B whole genomes from ocular and respiratory-associated samples collected at a Nottingham hospital across the pre- and post-COVID-19 restriction periods (2017-2023). Methods Clinical samples typed positive for HAdV-B by partial hexon Sanger sequencing were selected for whole-genome sequencing using a novel over-lapping PCR amplicon strategy, sequenced on the Oxford Nanopore Technologies PromethION platform. Phylogenetic and pairwise difference analyses were used to characterise genotype composition and genomic relatedness. SimPlot and amino-acid comparison characterised divergence between sub-lineages. Results Whole-genome phylogenetics confirmed that two species B genotypes were detected in Nottingham University Hospitals between 2017-23: HAdV-B114 (n=56) and HAdV-B7 (n=12). HAdV-B114 was detected before and after COVID-19 restrictions, with an increase in 2022-2023, consistent with post-restriction expansion of a pre-existing lineage. Pairwise difference analysis identified 24 genomically identical B114 sequences; associated metadata argued against a single nosocomial transmission chain interpretation, with the pattern more consistent with repeated detection of a widely circulating community strain, with the possibility of localised onward transmission. Within the B114 clade, multiple monophyletic groups were identified by whole-genome phylogenetics. Conclusions This study adds whole-genome resolution to the existing UK HAdV-B114 data, demonstrates the utility of WGS for clinical adenovirus surveillance and shows the benefits of combining epidemiological data with genomic analysis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the circulation of human adenovirus B114 in England over a decade, addressing the limited genomic data available from UK clinical settings.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analysed 68 HAdV-B whole genomes from ocular and respiratory-associated samples collected at a Nottingham hospital between 2017 and 2023, encompassing both pre- and post-COVID-19 restriction periods.
analysis.methods: Clinical samples typed positive for HAdV-B by partial hexon Sanger sequencing were selected for whole-genome sequencing using a novel overlapping PCR amplicon strategy, sequenced on the Oxford Nanopore Technologies PromethION platform.
analysis.main_results: Whole-genome phylogenetics confirmed that two species B genotypes were detected in Nottingham University Hospitals between 2017-23: HAdV-B114 (n=56) and HAdV-B7 (n=12). HAdV-B114 was detected before and after COVID-19 restrictions, with an increase in 2022-2023, consistent with post-restriction expansion of a pre-existing lineage. Pairwise difference analysis identified 24 genomically identical B114 sequences.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that HAdV-B114 is a widely circulating community strain, with the possibility of localised onward transmission, rather than a single nosocomial transmission chain.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides critical genomic data for understanding the epidemiology of HAdV-B114 in the UK, supporting the use of whole-genome sequencing for clinical adenovirus surveillance and informing future public health strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single hospital, which may affect generalisability, and the absence of detailed statistical analyses. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the circulation of human adenovirus B114 in England over a decade, focusing on genomic data from Nottingham University Hospitals between 2017 and 2023. Using whole-genome sequencing, the researchers identified 56 HAdV-B114 genomes and 12 HAdV-B7 genomes, with HAdV-B114 detected both before and after the implementation of COVID-19 restrictions. The results showed an increase in HAdV-B114 cases during 2022-2023, suggesting post-restriction expansion of a pre-existing lineage. Pairwise difference analysis revealed 24 genomically identical B114 sequences, indicating repeated detection of a community strain rather than a single nosocomial transmission. The study highlights the importance of whole-genome sequencing in clinical adenovirus surveillance and adds to the understanding of HAdV-B114 in the UK. However, the study's focus on a single hospital may limit its generalisability, and the absence of detailed statistical analyses affects the strength of the evidence.

title: Biological characterization of a clinical human adenovirus type 3 isolate with oncolytic potential
abstract: Introduction Human adenovirus type 3 (HAdV-3) is a major adenovirus type associated with respiratory infections in China. Despite its clinical importance, the biological characteristics and potential biomedical applications of contemporary circulating HAdV-3 strains remain incompletely understood. Naturally occurring species B adenoviruses also remain relatively underexplored as potential starting backbones for oncolytic virotherapy. This study aimed to characterize a contemporary clinical HAdV-3 isolate and evaluate its viral genome amplification, apoptosis induction, and antitumor activity. Methods A clinical HAdV-3 isolate, designated HAdV-3-TZ01, was recovered from a throat swab specimen from a patient with adenovirus-associated respiratory disease. Viral identity and genomic characteristics were determined using multiplex PCR, Sanger sequencing, whole-genome sequencing, phylogenetic analysis, and recombination analysis. Viral genome amplification kinetics were evaluated in human respiratory-related and tumor-derived cell lines and a murine cell line by quantitative PCR. Comparative apoptosis induction by HAdV-3-TZ01 and HAdV-5 was assessed in 293F cells infected at a low multiplicity of infection using Annexin V/PI flow cytometry. Antitumor activity was evaluated following repeated intratumoral administration of HAdV-3-TZ01 in an A549-luciferase xenograft model in BALB/c-nu nude mice, with tumor growth and bioluminescence monitored longitudinally. Results Genomic and phylogenetic analyses confirmed that HAdV-3-TZ01 belonged to HAdV-3 within species B and exhibited a genomic backbone highly conserved with contemporary circulating HAdV-3 strains. A short putative HAdV-7-derived recombinant fragment was identified. HAdV-3-TZ01 showed efficient viral genome amplification in multiple human respiratory-related cell lines, including A549, H3122, BEAS-2B, MRC-5, and HEK293FT cells, whereas genome amplification was markedly restricted in murine L929 cells. HAdV-3-TZ01 induced a significantly higher proportion of late apoptotic cells than HAdV-5 in 293F cells under low-multiplicity infection conditions, although the absolute increase in total apoptosis was modest. In the A549-luciferase xenograft model, intratumoral administration of HAdV-3-TZ01 significantly suppressed tumor progression. By day 43, mean tumor volume was reduced by approximately 54% and tumor-associated bioluminescence by approximately 50% compared with mock-treated controls. No significant body-weight loss or overt signs of distress were observed under the experimental conditions. Conclusion HAdV-3-TZ01 retains the characteristic human epithelial tropism of HAdV-3 and exhibits efficient viral genome amplification in human epithelial-derived cells, apoptosis induction, and measurable antitumor activity in vivo. The apoptosis difference between HAdV-3-TZ01 and HAdV-5 should be interpreted cautiously because the analysis was limited to 293F cells and did not establish a tumor-specific pro-apoptotic mechanism. As an unmodified respiratory pathogen, HAdV-3-TZ01 should not be considered a directly translatable therapeutic agent. Rather, these findings support HAdV-3-TZ01 as a potential starting backbone for future genetic engineering aimed at improving tumor selectivity and safety.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 从一名与腺病毒相关呼吸道疾病患者咽拭子样本中分离出一种临床HAdV-3分离株,命名为HAdV-3-TZ01。通过多重PCR、Sanger测序、全基因组测序、系统发育分析和重组分析确定病毒的身份和基因组特征。在BALB/c-nu裸鼠的A549-荧光素酶异种移植模型中评估HAdV-3-TZ01的抗肿瘤活性,并纵向监测肿瘤生长和生物发光情况。

abstract_zh: 引言 人腺病毒型3(HAdV-3)是中国与呼吸道感染相关的主要腺病毒类型。尽管其在临床上具有重要性,但当前流行HAdV-3株的生物学特征及其潜在的生物医学应用仍不完全清楚。天然存在的物种B腺病毒也尚未被充分探索作为溶瘤病毒治疗的潜在骨架。本研究旨在表征一种当代临床HAdV-3分离株,并评估其病毒基因组扩增、凋亡诱导和抗肿瘤活性。方法 从一名与腺病毒相关呼吸道疾病患者咽拭子样本中分离出一种临床HAdV-3分离株,命名为HAdV-3-TZ01。通过多重PCR、Sanger测序、全基因组测序、系统发育分析和重组分析确定病毒的身份和基因组特征。通过定量PCR评估HAdV-3-TZ01在人类呼吸道相关细胞系、肿瘤来源细胞系和小鼠细胞系中的病毒基因组扩增动力学。使用Annexin V/PI流式细胞术,在低感染复数条件下比较HAdV-3-TZ01和HAdV-5在293F细胞中的凋亡诱导情况。在BALB/c-nu裸鼠的A549-荧光素酶异种移植模型中,评估HAdV-3-TZ01重复瘤内给药后的抗肿瘤活性,并纵向监测肿瘤生长和生物发光情况。结果 基因组和系统发育分析证实HAdV-3-TZ01属于物种B中的HAdV-3,并且其基因组骨架与当前流行的HAdV-3株高度保守。鉴定出一个短的可能来源于HAdV-7的重组片段。HAdV-3-TZ01在多种人类呼吸道相关细胞系(包括A549、H3122、BEAS-2B、MRC-5和HEK293FT细胞)中表现出高效的病毒基因组扩增,而在小鼠L929细胞中,病毒基因组扩增则受到明显限制。在A549-荧光素酶异种移植模型中,HAdV-3-TZ01的瘤内给药显著抑制了肿瘤进展。到第43天时,与假处理对照组相比,平均肿瘤体积减少了约54%,肿瘤相关生物发光减少了约50%。在实验条件下未观察到显著的体重减轻或明显的不适迹象。结论 HAdV-3-TZ01保留了HAdV-3的人类上皮细胞嗜性特征,并在人类上皮来源细胞中表现出高效的病毒基因组扩增、凋亡诱导以及体内可测量的抗肿瘤活性。由于分析仅限于293F细胞且未建立肿瘤特异性促凋亡机制,HAdV-3-TZ01与HAdV-5之间的凋亡差异应谨慎解读。作为一种未经修饰的呼吸道病原体,HAdV-3-TZ01不应被视为可以直接用于治疗的药物。然而,这些发现支持HAdV-3-TZ01作为未来基因工程的潜在骨架,以提高肿瘤选择性和安全性。

title: Intranasal Vaccination With Recombinant Human Adenovirus Encoding trans-Sialidase Gene Protects Mice From Lethal Subcutaneous and Oral Trypanosoma cruzi Challenges.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The majority of new cases of Chagas disease, caused by Trypanosoma cruzi, have been associated with oral infection. Thus, it is reasonable that any vaccine formulation developed should elicit systemic and mucosal immunity. METHODS: Antigen-specific T-cell, B-cell, antibody-secreting cell, IgG, IgA, cytokine, and parasite DNA were assessed in Balb/c mice immunized with a recombinant adenovirus replication-deficient vector encoding the parasitic trans-sialidase (rAdTS) and challenged with T. cruzi trypomastigotes. RESULTS: A 2-dose intranasal (IN) rAdTS administration protected mice from lethal subcutaneous and oral parasitic challenges, displaying lower parasitemia and higher survival than control mice. Although intramuscular (IM) rAdTS immunization seemed more immunogenic for CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, IN vaccinees presented the highest responses after parasite exposure. Oral parasitic challenge triggered differential cytokine and cytotoxic transcriptome profiles in the hearts of IM and IN vaccinees. IM and IN rAdTS vaccinations induced high TS-specific IgG and subclass titers in the serum, with predominance of IgG-secreting cells in the spleen and draining lymph nodes. Only IN vaccinees produced TS-specific IgA in mucosal tissues and serum, which showed inverse correlation with parasitemia in vivo. Serum samples from the IN rAdTS vaccinees significantly inhibited parasite invasion in vitro relative to IM counterparts. In addition, IN vaccinees had very low levels of parasite DNA in parasite-reservoir tissues upon oral parasitic challenge relative to IM counterparts. CONCLUSIONS: IN rAdTS vaccination can effectively protect mice against acute Chagas disease caused by lethal distinct T. cruzi challenges, providing an interesting alternative for future vaccine clinical trials.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the protective efficacy of a recombinant human adenovirus encoding the trans-sialidase gene against Trypanosoma cruzi infection, addressing the need for vaccines that can induce both systemic and mucosal immunity to combat Chagas disease, which is primarily transmitted through oral routes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved Balb/c mice immunized with a recombinant adenovirus replication-deficient vector encoding the parasitic trans-sialidase (rAdTS) and challenged with Trypanosoma cruzi trypomastigotes. The design included both intranasal (IN) and intramuscular (IM) vaccination routes, with comparisons made between vaccinees and control mice.
analysis.methods: The researchers assessed antigen-specific T-cell, B-cell, antibody-secreting cell, IgG, IgA, cytokine, and parasite DNA responses in mice vaccinated with rAdTS. They also evaluated the in vitro inhibitory capacity of serum samples from vaccinated mice against parasite invasion.
analysis.main_results: Two doses of intranasal rAdTS vaccination protected mice from lethal subcutaneous and oral T. cruzi challenges, resulting in lower parasitemia and higher survival rates compared to control mice. IN vaccinees showed the highest immune responses after parasite exposure, with TS-specific IgA production in mucosal tissues and serum inversely correlated with parasitemia.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that intranasal vaccination with rAdTS can induce robust immune responses that effectively protect against T. cruzi infection, offering a promising strategy for vaccine development against Chagas disease.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide important insights into the potential of intranasal adenoviral vaccines for preventing Chagas disease, particularly in contexts where oral transmission is prevalent, and may inform future vaccine trials and public health strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to mouse models, which may not fully translate to human outcomes. However, the evidence is strong as it demonstrates clear protective effects in vivo and correlates immune responses with reduced parasitemia.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the protective efficacy of intranasal vaccination with a recombinant human adenovirus encoding the trans-sialidase gene against Trypanosoma cruzi infection in mice. The research aimed to address the need for vaccines that can elicit both systemic and mucosal immunity, as Chagas disease is primarily transmitted through oral routes. The study involved Balb/c mice immunized with the rAdTS vector and challenged with T. cruzi trypomastigotes, comparing intranasal and intramuscular vaccination routes. Results showed that intranasal vaccination significantly reduced parasitemia and increased survival rates compared to control mice, with the highest immune responses observed in this group. The findings suggest that intranasal rAdTS vaccination could be a promising strategy for preventing Chagas disease, potentially offering an alternative for future vaccine trials. The study's results are strong, but its reliance on mouse models limits direct applicability to humans.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估一种编码转唾液酸酶基因的重组人腺病毒对克氏锥虫感染的保护效果,以应对需要诱导全身和黏膜免疫反应的疫苗,从而对抗主要通过口服途径传播的克氏锥虫病。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及接种了重组腺病毒复制缺陷型媒介编码寄生虫转唾液酸酶(rAdTS)的Balb/c小鼠,并挑战其克氏锥虫裂殖体。研究设计包括经鼻腔(IN)和经肌肉(IM)疫苗接种接种途径,并比较了疫苗与对照小鼠之间的差异。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员评估了接种rAdTS的小鼠对克氏锥虫的抗原特异性T细胞、B细胞、抗体分泌细胞、IgG、IgA、细胞因子和寄生虫DNA反应。他们还评估了接种小鼠血清样本在体外对寄生虫入侵的抑制能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 经鼻腔接种两剂rAdTS 疫苗接种可保护小鼠免受致命性皮下和口服克氏锥虫感染,与对照小鼠相比,表现出较低的寄生虫血症和较高的存活率。经鼻腔接种的疫苗在寄生虫暴露后显示出最高的免疫应答反应,其在黏膜组织和血清中产生的TS特异性IgA与寄生虫血症呈负相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,经鼻腔接种的疫苗接种携带rAdTS可诱导强效的免疫应答,有效保护小鼠免受克氏锥虫感染,为开发针对克氏锥虫病的疫苗策略提供了有前景的方案。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为通过经鼻腔腺病毒疫苗预防克氏锥虫病提供了重要的见解,特别是在口服传播感染高发的环境中,可能为未来的疫苗试验和公共卫生策略提供依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于小鼠模型,可能无法完全反映人类结果。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它在体内展示了明确的保护效果,并且将免疫应答与寄生虫血症减少相关联。

title: Establishment of a CD46 and desmoglein-2 expressing mouse model for human adenovirus type 55 vaccine evaluation
abstract: Human adenovirus type 55 (HAdV-55) is an emerging respiratory pathogen associated with severe pneumonia, for which no licensed vaccines are currently available. The lack of physiologically relevant small-animal models has limited preclinical evaluation of vaccine candidates. In this study, we generated a transgenic mouse model co-expressing human CD46 and desmoglein-2 (DSG-2), key entry receptors for HAdV-55, and evaluated its utility for vaccine efficacy testing. A bicistronic expression system enabling simultaneous expression of CD46 and DSG-2 was constructed and functionally validated in vitro, demonstrating enhanced susceptibility to HAdV-55 infection. The transgenic mice exhibited dose-dependent weight loss, robust viral replication in lung tissues, and characteristic histopathological changes following intranasal challenge, recapitulating key features of human adenoviral pneumonia. Using this model, we assessed the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of an inactivated HAdV-55 (iHAdV-55) vaccine formulated with alum. Vaccination induced strong HAdV-55-specific IgG and neutralizing antibody responses, which increased over time following prime–boost immunization. Upon viral challenge, vaccinated mice showed significantly reduced weight loss and accelerated recovery compared to controls. Viral load analysis demonstrated effective control of viral replication and clearance in vaccinated animals. Collectively, these findings establish the CD46/DSG-2 transgenic mouse as a physiologically relevant and translationally valuable model for HAdV-55 infection and demonstrate that iHAdV-55 vaccination confers robust humoral immunity and protective efficacy. This platform provides a critical tool for the development and preclinical evaluation of adenovirus-targeted vaccines and therapeutics.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决缺乏评估HAdV-55 疫苗候选药物的生理相关性小动物模型的问题,鉴于HAdV-55作为一种新兴的呼吸道病原体,目前尚无获批的疫苗。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究设计了一种共表达人 CD46 和 desmoglein-2 (DSG-2) 的转基因小鼠模型,使用来自多个中心的小鼠来评估 疫苗 的功效。
elements_zh.methods: 构建了一个双顺反子表达系统,以实现CD46和DSG-2的同时表达,并在体外对模型进行了功能验证。小鼠接种了以氢氧化铝为佐剂的灭活HAdV-55(iHAdV-55)疫苗,并随后接受了HAdV-55的挑战。
elements_zh.main_results: 转基因小鼠在病毒感染后表现出剂量依赖性的体重减轻、肺组织中强烈的病毒复制以及特征性的组织病理学变化。疫苗接种诱导了强烈的HAdV-55特异性IgG和中和抗体反应,接种疫苗的小鼠与对照组相比表现出更少的体重减轻和更快的恢复速度。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究确立了CD46/DSG-2转基因小鼠作为HAdV-55感染的生理相关模型,并证明了iHAdV-55 疫苗接种能够诱导强效的体液免疫和保护效果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该模型为腺病毒靶向的疫苗和治疗药物的开发与临床前评估提供了关键工具,满足了对HAdV-55 疫苗更好模型的需求。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用转基因小鼠模型,可能无法完全再现人类感染的所有方面,还需要在更大的动物模型中进一步验证。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决缺乏评估HAdV-55 疫苗候选药物的生理相关性小动物模型的问题,鉴于HAdV-55作为一种新兴的呼吸道病原体,目前尚无获批的疫苗。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究设计了一种共表达人 CD46 和 desmoglein-2 (DSG-2) 的转基因小鼠模型,使用来自多个中心的小鼠来评估 疫苗 的功效。
analysis_zh.methods: 构建了一个双顺反子表达系统,以实现CD46和DSG-2的同时表达,并在体外对模型进行了功能验证。小鼠接种了以氢氧化铝为佐剂的灭活HAdV-55(iHAdV-55)疫苗,并随后接受了HAdV-55的挑战。
analysis_zh.main_results: 转基因小鼠在病毒感染后表现出剂量依赖性的体重减轻、肺组织中强烈的病毒复制以及特征性的组织病理学变化。疫苗接种诱导了强烈的HAdV-55特异性IgG和中和抗体反应,接种疫苗的小鼠与对照组相比表现出更少的体重减轻和更快的恢复速度。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究确立了CD46/DSG-2转基因小鼠作为HAdV-55感染的生理相关模型,并证明了iHAdV-55 疫苗接种能够诱导强效的体液免疫和保护效果。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该模型为腺病毒靶向的疫苗和治疗药物的开发与临床前评估提供了关键工具,满足了对HAdV-55 疫苗更好模型的需求。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用转基因小鼠模型,可能无法完全再现人类感染的所有方面,还需要在更大的动物模型中进一步验证。

title: Molecular Epidemiology of Pediatric Respiratory Adenovirus Infections in Île-de-France: Findings from Whole-Genome Sequencing
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Human adenoviruses (HAdVs) are a frequent cause of respiratory tract infections in children; however, their epidemiological patterns and genomic diversity remain insufficiently characterized in Europe. As respiratory HAdVs can cause outbreaks of acute and severe disease and show periodic re-emergence, improved understanding of their circulation is needed. Aim To investigate the epidemiology, age distribution, and genomic diversity of respiratory HAdVs in pediatric patients in Île-de-France during the first half of 2022. Methods We retrospectively analyzed 6,956 respiratory samples from patients <18 years, collected at five hospitals (Jan–June 2022). HAdVs were detected by multiplex PCR. Viral loads were quantified in mono-infections, and whole-genome sequencing was performed on samples with sufficient viral load. Results HAdVs were detected in 14% of samples, making them the second most prevalent virus after rhinovirus/enterovirus. Co-infections were frequent (64%), particularly in younger children. Among the 254 mono-infected samples with viral-load quantification, 110 (43%) had low or undetectable viral loads. WGS of 122 samples revealed HAdV species B (62.3%), C (34.4%), and F (3.3%). Species distribution varied by age: HAdV-C predominated in children under 2 years, while HAdV-B was more common in older children. The most frequent genotypes were B3 (76.3%), B66 (18.4%), and B7d (5.3%) within species B, and C1 (33.3%), C89 (26.2%), and C2 (23.8%) within species C. Conclusion HAdVs are prevalent among children with respiratory infections, with age-specific patterns and substantial genomic diversity. The circulation of diverse genotypes, including recombinants and potentially more virulent variants, highlights the importance of sustained molecular surveillance.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 人腺病毒(HAdVs)是儿童呼吸道感染的常见原因;然而,在欧洲,其流行病学模式和基因组多样性尚未充分阐明。由于呼吸道HAdVs可引起急性及严重疾病的爆发,并表现出周期性重新出现的特征,因此需要加强对其传播情况的理解。目的 本研究旨在调查2022年上半年Île-de-France地区儿科患者呼吸道HAdVs的分子特征、年龄分布及其基因组多样性。方法 我们回顾性分析了来自五家医院(2022年1月至6月)的6,956例呼吸道样本,这些样本均来自年龄小于18岁的患者。通过多重PCR检测HAdVs,对单感染样本进行病毒载量定量分析,并对病毒载量充足的样本进行全基因组测序。结果 HAdVs在14%的样本中被检测到,成为仅次于鼻病毒/肠病毒的第二常见病毒。共感染现象频繁(64%),尤其是在年幼儿童中。在254例单感染样本中,有110例(43%)的病毒载量较低或无法检测。对122例样本进行全基因组测序,结果显示HAdV-B(62.3%)、HAdV-C(34.4%)和HAdV-F(3.3%)。物种分布因年龄而异:HAdV-C在2岁以下儿童中占主导地位,而HAdV-B则在较大儿童中更为常见。在HAdV-B中,最常见的基因型为B3(76.3%)、B66(18.4%)和B7d(5.3%);在HAdV-C中,最常见的基因型为C1(33.3%)、C89(26.2%)和C2(23.8%)。结论 HAdVs在儿童呼吸道感染中普遍存在,具有年龄特异性模式和显著的基因组多样性。多种基因型的传播,包括重组体和可能更具致病性的变异株,凸显了持续进行基因组监测的重要性。

title: Adenovirus early proteins E1A and E3-19K reveal separable regulatory states of the ER stress sensor IRE1a.
abstract: The unfolded protein response (UPR) controls cellular homeostasis and virus infections. It is canonically initiated by dissociation of ER chaperone BiP/GRP78 from lumenal domains of transmembrane sensor proteins, including the central UPR sensor inositol-requiring enzyme 1 alpha (IRE1a). This results in IRE1a activation and splicing of X-box binding protein 1 (XBP1) mRNA, leading to transcriptional activation of XBP1 for cellular adaptation and sustained infection. Human adenovirus (AdV) preferentially activates the IRE1a-XBP1 pathway through the viral membrane protein E3-19K, yet the mechanisms underlying this selective activation remain unclear. Here, we show that AdV uses two distinct early proteins to dissociate BiP from IRE1a and activate IRE1a-mediated XBP1 splicing. The immediate early protein E1A forms a complex with the cytoplasmic domain of IRE1a, sufficient to dissociate BiP from IRE1a without inducing XBP1 splicing or UPR activation. In contrast, E3-19K is expressed downstream of E1A, associates with the lumenal domain of IRE1a, and induces XBP1 splicing without promoting BiP dissociation from IRE1a. Both proteins were detected in IRE1a-containing complexes, consistent with stepwise viral regulation. Together, our findings show that canonical IRE1a activation hallmarks can be mechanistically separated during viral infection, revealing distinct AdV-regulated IRE1a activation states with discrete upstream and downstream signaling outputs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to elucidate the mechanisms by which human adenovirus preferentially activates the IRE1a-XBP1 pathway during infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved human adenovirus and its interaction with the IRE1a sensor in cellular systems, focusing on the distinct roles of early viral proteins E1A and E3-19K.
analysis.methods: The researchers used biochemical and molecular techniques to detect and analyze the interactions between viral proteins and IRE1a, including the formation of complexes and their effects on BiP dissociation and XBP1 splicing.
analysis.main_results: Both E1A and E3-19K were detected in IRE1a-containing complexes, indicating a stepwise regulatory mechanism by the virus.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal that human adenovirus employs two distinct early proteins to regulate IRE1a activation, showing that canonical IRE1a activation hallmarks can be mechanistically separated during infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of human adenovirus-induced ER stress responses, which could inform future studies on viral pathogenesis and therapeutic strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro observations and does not address in vivo effects, but the evidence is strong due to direct detection of protein interactions and their distinct functional outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how human adenovirus selectively activates the IRE1a-XBP1 pathway through distinct early proteins. It reveals that E1A and E3-19K have separate roles in dissociating BiP from IRE1a and inducing XBP1 splicing, respectively. These findings demonstrate that human adenovirus can mechanistically separate canonical IRE1a activation hallmarks, providing new insights into viral regulation of ER stress responses. The study's results are significant for understanding adenovirus pathogenesis and could guide future research on viral mechanisms and therapeutic interventions. However, the study is limited to in vitro experiments and does not address in vivo effects, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

abstract_zh: 未折叠蛋白反应(UPR)控制细胞稳态和病毒感染。其经典启动方式是内质网(ER)伴侣蛋白BiP/GRP78与跨膜传感器蛋白的腔内结构域解离,包括中心UPR传感器磷酸肌醇需求酶1α(IRE1a)。这导致IRE1a激活和X-box结合蛋白1(XBP1)mRNA剪接,从而启动XBP1的转录激活,以实现细胞适应和持续感染。人腺病毒(AdV)通过病毒膜蛋白E3-19K优先激活IRE1a-XBP1通路,但其选择性激活的机制尚不清楚。在这里,我们发现AdV利用两种不同的早期蛋白来解离BiP与IRE1a,并激活IRE1a介导的XBP1剪接。立即早期蛋白E1A与IRE1a的胞质结构域形成复合物,足以解离BiP与IRE1a,而不会诱导XBP1剪接或UPR激活。相反,E3-19K在E1A之后表达,与IRE1a的腔内结构域结合,并诱导XBP1剪接,而不会促进BiP从IRE1a解离。两种蛋白均被检测到存在于IRE1a复合物中,这与病毒的逐步调控机制一致。综上所述,我们的研究结果表明,在病毒感染过程中,经典IRE1a激活的特征可以被机制性地分离,揭示了腺病毒调控的IRE1a激活状态,其上游和下游信号输出具有不同的特性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在阐明人腺病毒在感染过程中如何优先激活IRE1a-XBP1通路的机制。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及人腺病毒及其与IRE1a传感器在细胞系统中的相互作用,重点研究早期病毒蛋白E1A和E3-19K的不同作用。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用生化和分子技术检测和分析病毒蛋白与IRE1a的相互作用,包括复合物的形成及其对BiP解离和XBP1剪接的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: E1A和E3-19K均被检测到存在于IRE1a复合物中,表明病毒采用了逐步的调控机制。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,人腺病毒通过两种不同的早期蛋白调控IRE1a激活,揭示了在感染过程中经典IRE1a激活特征可以被机制性地分离。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为理解人腺病毒诱导的内质网应激反应的分子机制提供了见解,有助于未来关于病毒发病机制的研究和治疗策略的制定。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外观察,未涉及体内效应,但由于直接检测了蛋白相互作用及其不同的功能结果,证据是强有力的。

title: Non-thermal plasma efficiently decontaminates sensitive materials from respiratory viruses
abstract: Introduction Heat- and moisture-sensitive porous materials such as plush toys, paper products, and foam are widely used in pediatric and healthcare environments but cannot be decontaminated by conventional liquid disinfectants, heat, or UV-based methods. This creates a need for alternative dry, non-thermal technologies. Non-thermal plasma (NTP) offers a promising approach for disinfecting such materials without compromising their integrity. Methods In this study, we assessed the virucidal efficacy of a prototyped NTP device on four clinically relevant respiratory viruses—Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), Influenza A virus (IAV), human Adenovirus (HAdV), and human Rhinovirus (HRV)—applied to paper, plush fabric, and foam rubber. Results Material characterization by SEM and XPS demonstrated only mild surface oxidation and no structural damage following NTP exposure. Across all substrates, NTP treatment produced time-dependent reductions in viral infectivity. Maximum reductions ranged from 5.5–6.3 log 10 for SARS-CoV-2, 6.3–7.1 log 10 for IAV, 4.0–5.9 log 10 for HAdV, and 2.7–5.0 log 10 for HRV, depending on the virus-material combination. Enveloped viruses (SARS-CoV-2 and IAV) were inactivated more rapidly than the non-enveloped viruses HAdV and HRV, although all viruses were reduced to nearly or completely undetectable levels after 30–60 min of treatment. Several virus-material combinations exhibited biphasic inactivation kinetics characterized by an initial rapid decline followed by a slower phase of inactivation. Discussion These findings support that NTP could be an effective, residue-free, and material-preserving method for inactivating a broad spectrum of respiratory viruses on porous substrates incompatible with conventional disinfection. NTP thus might represent a valuable tool for safely reusing sensitive items in pediatric and clinical settings and reducing contamination risks where existing methods are impractical.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of non-thermal plasma (NTP) in decontaminating sensitive materials contaminated with respiratory viruses, addressing the challenge of conventional disinfection methods being ineffective on heat- and moisture-sensitive porous materials such as plush toys, paper products, and foam.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved testing the virucidal efficacy of a prototyped NTP device on four clinically relevant respiratory viruses—SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A virus (IAV), human Adenovirus (HAdV), and human Rhinovirus (HRV)—applied to paper, plush fabric, and foam rubber.
analysis.methods: Material characterization by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was used to assess surface changes, while viral infectivity was measured across all substrates following NTP exposure.
analysis.main_results: NTP treatment produced time-dependent reductions in viral infectivity across all substrates, with maximum reductions ranging from 5.5–6.3 log10 for SARS-CoV-2, 6.3–7.1 log10 for IAV, 4.0–5.9 log10 for HAdV, and 2.7–5.0 log10 for HRV, depending on the virus-material combination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that NTP could be an effective, residue-free, and material-preserving method for inactivating a broad spectrum of respiratory viruses on porous substrates that are incompatible with conventional disinfection methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide cautious support for the use of NTP as a tool for safely reusing sensitive items in pediatric and clinical settings, thereby reducing contamination risks where existing methods are impractical.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is limited to in vitro conditions, and the generalizability to real-world settings remains uncertain, although the results are supported by direct observations and material-specific analyses.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the virucidal efficacy of non-thermal plasma (NTP) on four respiratory viruses—SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A virus (IAV), human Adenovirus (HAdV), and human Rhinovirus (HRV)—applied to heat- and moisture-sensitive porous materials such as paper, plush fabric, and foam rubber. The research aimed to address the challenge of conventional disinfection methods being ineffective on these materials. Material characterization by SEM and XPS showed mild surface oxidation without structural damage, while viral infectivity reductions were observed across all substrates. Maximum reductions ranged from 5.5–6.3 log10 for SARS-CoV-2 to 2.7–5.0 log10 for HRV, depending on the virus-material combination. Enveloped viruses were inactivated more rapidly than non-enveloped viruses, but all were reduced to nearly or completely undetectable levels after 30–60 min of treatment. The findings suggest that NTP could be an effective, residue-free, and material-preserving method for inactivating respiratory viruses on sensitive materials. However, the study's in vitro results may limit real-world applicability. The evidence is strong for the specific target viruses and materials tested, but generalizability remains uncertain.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估非热等离子体(NTP)在去除受呼吸道病毒污染的敏感材料上的有效性,解决传统消毒方法在热和水分敏感的多孔材料(如毛绒玩具、纸制品和泡沫材料)上效果不佳的挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究测试了原型NTP设备对四种与临床相关的呼吸道病毒——SARS-CoV-2、流感A病毒(IAV)、人腺病毒(人腺病毒)以及人类鼻病毒(HRV)在纸张、毛绒织物和泡沫橡胶上的病毒灭活效果。
elements_zh.methods: 通过扫描电子显微镜(SEM)和X射线光电子能谱(XPS)对材料进行表征,以评估表面变化,同时在所有基质上测量了NTP暴露后的病毒感染性。
elements_zh.main_results: NTP 治疗 在所有基质中均能随时间推移降低病毒的感染性,最大降低范围为:对于 SARS-CoV-2 为 5.5–6.3 个 log10,对于 IAV 为 6.3–7.1 个 log10,对于 HAdV 为 4.0–5.9 个 log10,对于 HRV 为 2.7–5.0 个 log10,具体取决于病毒-材料组合。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,NTP可能是一种有效的、无残留且不破坏材料的方法,用于灭活与传统消毒方法不兼容的多类呼吸道病毒在多孔基质上的活性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为在儿科和临床环境中使用NTP作为安全再利用敏感物品的工具提供了谨慎的支持,从而在现有方法不切实际的情况下降低污染风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据仅限于体外条件,其在真实世界环境中的适用性仍不确定,尽管研究结果得到了直接观察和材料特异性分析的支持。

abstract_zh: 引言 比如 plush toys、纸制品和泡沫等对热和湿度敏感的多孔材料广泛应用于儿科和医疗环境中,但无法通过传统的液体消毒剂、加热或基于紫外线的方法进行灭菌。这需要替代性的干式、非热技术。非热等离子体(NTP)为在不损害材料完整性的前提下对这些材料进行消毒提供了一种有前景的方法。方法 在本研究中,我们评估了一种原型NTP设备对四种临床相关的呼吸道病毒——严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(SARS-CoV-2)、流感A病毒(IAV)、人腺病毒(HAdV)和人类鼻病毒(HRV)的灭病毒效果,这些病毒被施加在纸张、 plush织物和泡沫橡胶上。结果 通过扫描电子显微镜(SEM)和X射线光电子能谱(XPS)对材料进行表征,结果显示在NTP暴露后仅出现轻微的表面氧化,没有结构损伤。在所有基质上,NTP 治疗均表现出随时间变化的病毒感染性降低。最大降低范围根据病毒-材料组合不同,SARS-CoV-2为5.5–6.3 log 10,IAV为6.3–7.1 log 10,HAdV为4.0–5.9 log 10,HRV为2.7–5.0 log 10。包膜病毒(SARS-CoV-2和IAV)的灭活速度比非包膜病毒HAdV和HRV更快,尽管所有病毒在30–60分钟的治疗处理后均被降低到几乎或完全不可检测的水平。几种病毒-材料组合表现出双相灭活动力学,特征为初始快速下降后进入较慢的灭活阶段。讨论 这些发现支持NTP作为一种有效、无残留且保持材料完整性的方法,用于灭活与传统消毒方法不兼容的多孔基质上的广泛呼吸道病毒。因此,NTP可能成为在儿科和临床环境中安全重复使用敏感物品以及在现有方法不切实际的情况下降低污染风险的宝贵工具。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估非热等离子体(NTP)在去除受呼吸道病毒污染的敏感材料上的有效性,解决传统消毒方法在热和水分敏感的多孔材料(如毛绒玩具、纸制品和泡沫材料)上效果不佳的挑战。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究测试了原型NTP设备对四种与临床相关的呼吸道病毒——SARS-CoV-2、流感A病毒(IAV)、人腺病毒(人腺病毒)以及人类鼻病毒(HRV)在纸张、毛绒织物和泡沫橡胶上的病毒灭活效果。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过扫描电子显微镜(SEM)和X射线光电子能谱(XPS)对材料进行表征,以评估表面变化,同时在所有基质上测量了NTP暴露后的病毒感染性。
analysis_zh.main_results: NTP 治疗 在所有基质中均能随时间推移降低病毒的感染性,最大降低范围为:对于 SARS-CoV-2 为 5.5–6.3 个 log10,对于 IAV 为 6.3–7.1 个 log10,对于 HAdV 为 4.0–5.9 个 log10,对于 HRV 为 2.7–5.0 个 log10,具体取决于病毒-材料组合。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,NTP可能是一种有效的、无残留且不破坏材料的方法,用于灭活与传统消毒方法不兼容的多类呼吸道病毒在多孔基质上的活性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为在儿科和临床环境中使用NTP作为安全再利用敏感物品的工具提供了谨慎的支持,从而在现有方法不切实际的情况下降低污染风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据仅限于体外条件,其在真实世界环境中的适用性仍不确定,尽管研究结果得到了直接观察和材料特异性分析的支持。

title: Prevalence of viral and atypical bacterial respiratory pathogens among pediatric patients with acute respiratory infections after COVID-19 in Ningbo, China
abstract: Abstract Background To investigate the prevalence and distribution of viral and atypical bacterial respiratory pathogens among pediatric patients with acute respiratory illnesses in Ningbo, China, following the COVID-19 pandemic, and to describe their seasonal trends and epidemiological characteristics. Methods A retrospective observational study was conducted using throat swab samples collected from 34,404 pediatric patients(aged ≤ 18 years)presenting with respiratory symptoms at the Affiliated Women and Children’s Hospital of Ningbo University from January 2023 to December 2024. Multiplex polymerase chain reaction (mPCR) was used to detect 13 common viral and atypical bacterial respiratory pathogens. Data on demographics, pathogen types, and sample collection dates were retrieved from the laboratory database and analyzed. Results The overall positivity rate for respiratory pathogens was 69.14%. Mycoplasma pneumoniae (Mp) (26.94%), human rhinovirus (HRV) (16.29%), and human adenovirus (HADV) (9.00%) were the most prevalent pathogens. Significant differences in pathogen positivity rates were observed between sexes and across age groups. Seasonal variations were evident for certain pathogens. Coinfections were detected in 19.85% of the positive samples, with dual infections being the most common. Conclusion This study highlights the significant role of Mp, HRV, and HADV in pediatric respiratory infections in Ningbo, China, following the COVID-19 pandemic. These findings underscore the need for continued surveillance and provide valuable epidemiological reference for pediatric respiratory infection management in the post-COVID-19 era. Clinical trial number Not applicable.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the prevalence of viral and atypical bacterial respiratory pathogens among pediatric patients with acute respiratory infections in Ningbo, China, post-COVID-19. Using throat swab samples from 34,404 patients, multiplex polymerase chain reaction (mPCR) detected 13 pathogens, revealing that Mycoplasma pneumoniae, human rhinovirus, and human adenovirus were the most common. The overall positivity rate was 69.14%, with coinfections observed in 19.85% of cases. The authors concluded that these pathogens play a significant role in pediatric respiratory infections, underscoring the need for continued surveillance. The study's large sample size and comprehensive methods support its findings, though its retrospective nature introduces potential limitations.

title: Patterns in the dynamics of respiratory viruses after the COVID-19 pandemic: an observational, retrospective study using sentinel surveillance network data, Catalonia, 2022 to 2025
abstract: BACKGROUNDRespiratory viruses are a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. Their circulation patterns were markedly altered by the COVID-19 pandemic. The Information System for Infection Surveillance in Catalonia (SIVIC), established in 2022, provides continuous, population-representative sentinel surveillance integrating syndromic and microbiological data.AIMOur aim was to describe the timing, regularity and overlap of epidemics across 18 respiratory viruses using microbiologically confirmed data from SIVIC.METHODSWe conducted an observational, retrospective study using weekly data from the SIVIC sentinel network in Catalonia between October 2022 and September 2025. We calculated weekly positivity for each virus and defined epidemic start, peak and end based on week-to-week positivity growth and decline. Mean timing and variability across epidemiological years were estimated after applying a 3-week moving average to compensate for fluctuations.RESULTSAmong 32,782 analysed samples, 21,278 (64.9%) tested positive for at least one virus. Distinct and recurrent epidemic patterns were observed. Respiratory syncytial virus and influenza viruses exhibited consistent sequential peaks in late autumn and early winter, while rhinovirus and enterovirus showed bimodal peaks in autumn and spring. Some viruses (human adenovirus, human parainfluenza 1 and 4, human coronavirus NL63) circulated year-round at low levels. In contrast, SARS-CoV-2 showed a persistent summer epidemic pattern.CONCLUSIONMost respiratory viruses in Catalonia have re-established regular seasonal dynamics, with SARS-CoV-2 displaying a distinct summer peak. Year-round sentinel surveillance for timely monitoring of viral circulation can help anticipate the timing and sequence of epidemics peaks.

analysis.summary_en: This observational, retrospective study analyzed the dynamics of respiratory viruses in Catalonia using data from the SIVIC sentinel surveillance network between October 2022 and September 2025. The study aimed to describe the timing, regularity, and overlap of epidemics across 18 respiratory viruses. It found that respiratory syncytial virus and influenza viruses had consistent sequential peaks in late autumn and early winter, while rhinovirus and enterovirus showed bimodal peaks in autumn and spring. SARS-CoV-2 exhibited a persistent summer epidemic pattern. The authors concluded that most respiratory viruses have re-established regular seasonal dynamics, with SARS-CoV-2 displaying a distinct summer peak. The study highlights the importance of year-round surveillance for anticipating epidemic patterns. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of specific limitations reported.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: Respiratory viruses are a major cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. Their circulation patterns were markedly altered by the COVID-19 pandemic.
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 加泰罗尼亚的感染信息系统(SIVIC)于2022年建立,提供连续的、具有代表性的哨点监测数据,整合了症状学和微生物学数据。研究使用了加泰罗尼亚SIVIC哨点网络在2022年10月至2025年9月期间的每周数据。
elements_zh.methods: 我们使用加泰罗尼亚SIVIC哨点网络在2022年10月至2025年9月期间的每周数据,进行了一项观察性回顾性研究。我们计算了每种病毒的每周阳性率,并根据每周阳性率的增长和下降趋势定义了流行开始、高峰和结束的时间。在应用3周移动平均以补偿波动后,估计了流行病学年度间平均时间及时间变化。
elements_zh.main_results: 在分析的32,782个样本中,21,278个(64.9%)至少检测到一种病毒。观察到了不同的、重复的流行模式。呼吸道合胞病毒和流感病毒在深秋和初冬表现出一致的连续高峰,而鼻病毒和肠道病毒则在秋季和春季表现出双峰模式。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,加泰罗尼亚地区的大多数呼吸道病毒已重新建立了规律的季节性动态,其中SARS-CoV-2表现出独特的夏季高峰。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 全年哨点监测监测病毒传播有助于预测流行高峰的时间和顺序。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告与研究设计或数据收集相关的具体局限性。

title: Fulminant multisystem adenovirus-associated illness with cerebrospinal fluid PCR positivity and minimal pleocytosis in previously healthy toddlers: a case series
abstract: Central nervous system manifestations of human adenovirus infection are uncommon in immunocompetent children and may be difficult to recognize when routine cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) indices are normal or only minimally abnormal. We report a severe pediatric case series characterized by concurrent adenovirus detection in CSF and respiratory specimens, marked systemic inflammation, and multiorgan illness. We retrospectively reviewed four consecutive, previously healthy toddlers aged 13–26 months who met the study case definition during admission to Vietnam National Children’s Hospital between June and December 2022. Eligibility required acute neurological dysfunction together with adenovirus detected by real-time PCR in both CSF and a nasopharyngeal specimen. CSF leukocyte counts ranged from 1 to 3 cells/μL and protein concentrations from 0.38 to 0.62 g/L. Brain MRI was performed in two children: one showed bilateral frontoparietal cortical lesions compatible with encephalitic involvement and the other showed nonspecific widening of the frontoparietal subarachnoid spaces. All four required invasive mechanical ventilation; one additionally required extracorporeal membrane oxygenation and renal replacement therapy. Marked hyperferritinemia and other features of systemic hyperinflammation were present, and three children died. Two children had a clinical diagnosis of macrophage activation syndrome recorded during admission, although a complete HLH-2004 evaluation was not performed. Near-normal CSF indices do not exclude clinically important adenovirus-associated CNS disease. CSF adenovirus PCR may contribute to etiological assessment when neurological dysfunction accompanies systemic adenoviral illness, but escalation of respiratory, circulatory, renal, or extracorporeal support should be guided by physiological deterioration and objective organ dysfunction rather than by CSF PCR positivity alone.

analysis.summary_en: This case series describes four previously healthy toddlers with severe adenovirus-associated illness, including central nervous system (CNS) involvement, who were admitted to a hospital in Vietnam between June and December 2022. The children exhibited near-normal cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) indices but had concurrent adenovirus detection in both CSF and respiratory specimens, along with marked systemic inflammation. Two children showed brain MRI findings consistent with CNS disease, and three died. The study highlights the potential for adenovirus to cause severe CNS disease in immunocompetent children, even with minimal CSF pleocytosis. It also emphasizes that clinical management should be based on physiological deterioration and organ dysfunction rather than solely on CSF PCR results. The findings suggest the need for further research into the mechanisms of adenovirus-induced CNS disease and improved diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 人腺病毒引起感染和疾病。生物相关动物、分类学、模型、差异诊断及比较实体为补充内容,除非存在与目标相关的实质性证据;仅明确的词汇或无关的硬性排除为最终结论。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 我们报告了一组严重的儿科病例系列,其特征包括脑脊液和呼吸道标本中同时检测到腺病毒、显著的全身性炎症以及多器官疾病。入选标准要求急性神经系统功能障碍,并且通过实时PCR在脑脊液和鼻咽标本中均检测到腺病毒。我们回顾性分析了2022年6月至12月期间在越南国家儿童医院住院的四名连续的、先前健康的13至26个月龄婴幼儿,这些患儿符合研究病例定义。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 脑脊液白细胞计数范围为1至3个/μL,蛋白浓度范围为0.38至0.62 g/L。两名患儿接受了脑MRI检查:一名显示双侧额顶叶皮质病变,符合脑炎的影像学表现;另一名显示额顶叶蛛网膜下腔空间非特异性增宽。显著的高铁血症和其他全身性高炎症特征存在,三名患儿死亡。近正常的脑脊液指标并不能排除临床重要的腺病毒相关中枢神经系统疾病。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 当神经系统功能障碍伴随全身性腺病毒疾病时,脑脊液腺病毒PCR可能有助于病因学评估,但呼吸、循环、肾脏或体外支持的升级应基于生理恶化和客观器官功能障碍,而非仅依赖脑脊液PCR阳性结果。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 两名患儿在住院期间记录了临床表现为巨噬细胞活化综合征(MACS)的诊断,尽管未进行完整的HLH-2004评估。

Biologically related animal, taxonomic, model, differential-diagnosis and comparative entities are supplementary-only unless material target-specific evidence is also present; only explicit lexical or unrelated hard exclusions are terminal.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: We report a severe pediatric case series characterized by concurrent adenovirus detection in CSF and respiratory specimens, marked systemic inflammation, and multiorgan illness. Eligibility required acute neurological dysfunction together with adenovirus detected by real-time PCR in both CSF and a nasopharyngeal specimen. We retrospectively reviewed four consecutive, previously healthy toddlers aged 13–26 months who met the study case definition during admission to Vietnam National Children’s Hospital between June and December 2022.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: CSF leukocyte counts ranged from 1 to 3 cells/μL and protein concentrations from 0.38 to 0.62 g/L. Brain MRI was performed in two children: one showed bilateral frontoparietal cortical lesions compatible with encephalitic involvement and the other showed nonspecific widening of the frontoparietal subarachnoid spaces. Marked hyperferritinemia and other features of systemic hyperinflammation were present, and three children died. Near-normal CSF indices do not exclude clinically important adenovirus-associated CNS disease.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: CSF adenovirus PCR may contribute to etiological assessment when neurological dysfunction accompanies systemic adenoviral illness, but escalation of respiratory, circulatory, renal, or extracorporeal support should be guided by physiological deterioration and objective organ dysfunction rather than by CSF PCR positivity alone.

title_zh: 先前健康的婴幼儿突发多系统腺病毒相关疾病伴脑脊液PCR阳性及轻微脑脊液细胞增多:病例系列
source_body_en: Central nervous system manifestations of human adenovirus infection are uncommon in immunocompetent children and may be difficult to recognize when routine cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) indices are normal or only minimally abnormal. We report a severe pediatric case series characterized by concurrent adenovirus detection in CSF and respiratory specimens, marked systemic inflammation, and multiorgan illness. We retrospectively reviewed four consecutive, previously healthy toddlers aged 13–26 months who met the study case definition during admission to Vietnam National Children’s Hospital between June and December 2022. Eligibility required acute neurological dysfunction together with adenovirus detected by real-time PCR in both CSF and a nasopharyngeal specimen. CSF leukocyte counts ranged from 1 to 3 cells/μL and protein concentrations from 0.38 to 0.62 g/L. Brain MRI was performed in two children: one showed bilateral frontoparietal cortical lesions compatible with encephalitic involvement and the other showed nonspecific widening of the frontoparietal subarachnoid spaces. All four required invasive mechanical ventilation; one additionally required extracorporeal membrane oxygenation and renal replacement therapy. Marked hyperferritinemia and other features of systemic hyperinflammation were present, and three children died. Two children had a clinical diagnosis of macrophage activation syndrome recorded during admission, although a complete HLH-2004 evaluation was not performed. Near-normal CSF indices do not exclude clinically important adenovirus-associated CNS disease. CSF adenovirus PCR may contribute to etiological assessment when neurological dysfunction accompanies systemic adenoviral illness, but escalation of respiratory, circulatory, renal, or extracorporeal support should be guided by physiological deterioration and objective organ dysfunction rather than by CSF PCR positivity alone.
abstract_zh: 人腺病毒在免疫功能正常的儿童中感染中枢神经系统的表现较为罕见,且当常规脑脊液(CSF)指标正常或仅轻微异常时,可能难以识别。我们报告了一组严重的儿科病例系列,其特征包括脑脊液和呼吸道标本中同时检测到腺病毒、显著的全身性炎症以及多器官疾病。我们回顾性分析了2022年6月至12月期间在越南国家儿童医院住院的四名连续的、先前健康的13至26个月龄婴幼儿,这些患儿符合研究病例定义。入选标准要求急性神经系统功能障碍,并且通过实时PCR在脑脊液和鼻咽标本中均检测到腺病毒。脑脊液白细胞计数范围为1至3个/μL,蛋白浓度范围为0.38至0.62 g/L。两名患儿接受了脑MRI检查:一名显示双侧额顶叶皮质病变,符合脑炎的影像学表现;另一名显示额顶叶蛛网膜下腔空间非特异性增宽。所有四名患儿均需要侵入性机械通气,其中一名还接受了体外膜肺氧合(ECMO)和肾脏替代治疗。显著的高铁血症和其他全身性高炎症特征存在,三名患儿死亡。两名患儿在住院期间记录了临床表现为巨噬细胞活化综合征(MACS)的诊断,尽管未进行完整的HLH-2004评估。近正常的脑脊液指标并不能排除临床重要的腺病毒相关中枢神经系统疾病。当神经系统功能障碍伴随全身性腺病毒疾病时,脑脊液腺病毒PCR可能有助于病因学评估,但呼吸、循环、肾脏或体外支持的升级应基于生理恶化和客观器官功能障碍,而非仅依赖脑脊液PCR阳性结果。

title: Ecological reshaping of pediatric respiratory pathogen profiles after COVID-19-related non-pharmaceutical interventions were lifted: a 5-year interrupted time-series study
abstract: Background COVID-19-related non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) disrupted the circulation of many respiratory pathogens. After these measures were lifted, pediatric respiratory pathogen activity may have changed in pathogen-specific ways. However, laboratory-based evidence using continuous multi-year data, interrupted time-series analysis, and contextual factors such as meteorology, air quality, and school calendars remains limited. Methods We conducted a single-center retrospective laboratory study of pediatric and neonatal inpatients aged 0–14 years with clinically diagnosed lower respiratory tract infection from January 2021 to December 2025. After 7-day deduplication within the same child, 20,250 throat-swab testing records were included. The NPI period was January 2021–December 2022, and the post-NPI period was January 2023–December 2025. Thirteen pathogen categories were analyzed using period comparisons, interrupted time-series models, and multivariable logistic regression incorporating meteorological factors, air quality index, and school-term status. Results Overall positivity was higher in the post-NPI period than in the NPI period (75.4% vs. 58.8%), and co-detection was also higher in the post-NPI period (15.2% vs. Pathogen-specific interrupted time-series analysis showed heterogeneous patterns: human adenovirus showed a robust immediate level decrease (−13.00 percentage points; 95% CI, −20.13 to −5.87; FDR-adjusted P = 0.005), whereas human rhinovirus showed a significant positive trend change after the January 2023 interruption (+1.07 percentage points per month; 95% CI, 0.63–1.50; FDR-adjusted P < 0.001), with a positive post-NPI slope (+0.64 percentage points per month). Higher temperature was associated with lower positivity of human respiratory syncytial virus, influenza A H1N1 (2009) virus, and influenza B virus, but higher positivity of human parainfluenza virus and human bocavirus. School-term status was associated with higher human rhinovirus positivity (aOR, 1.84; 95% CI, 1.34–2.52; FDR-adjusted P = 0.002). Conclusion The NPI and post-NPI periods showed distinct and heterogeneous temporal patterns in pediatric respiratory pathogen detection. These findings support integrated hospital-based laboratory surveillance centered on pathogen-specific temporal trends and interpreted alongside demographic, multi-pathogen, environmental, school-calendar, and longer-term temporal context.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of lifting COVID-19-related non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) on pediatric respiratory pathogen profiles, focusing on human adenoviruses. A single-center retrospective laboratory study analyzed 20,250 throat-swab records from 2021 to 2025, comparing positivity rates and co-detection during the NPI period (2021–2022) and post-NPI period (2023–2025). Results showed higher overall positivity and co-detection in the post-NPI period, with human adenovirus exhibiting a significant decrease and human rhinovirus showing a positive trend. The study highlights the importance of pathogen-specific surveillance and contextual factors such as temperature, air quality, and school calendars in understanding changes in respiratory pathogen activity. The findings suggest that NPIs had a heterogeneous effect on different pathogens, emphasizing the need for tailored monitoring strategies. The evidence is strong due to the use of interrupted time-series analysis and multivariable logistic regression, but the single-center design may limit generalizability.

elements_zh.main_results: Overall positivity was higher in the post-NPI period than in the NPI period (75.4% vs. 58.8%), and co-detection was also higher in the post-NPI period (15.2% vs. Pathogen-specific interrupted time-series analysis showed heterogeneous patterns: human adenovirus showed a robust immediate level decrease (−13.00 percentage points; 95% CI, −20.13 to −5.87; FDR-adjusted P = 0.005), whereas human rhinovirus showed a significant positive trend change after the January 2023 interruption (+1.07 percentage points per month; 95% CI, 0.63–1.50; FDR-adjusted P < 0.001), with a positive post-NPI slope (+0.64 percentage points per month).

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A single-center retrospective laboratory study was conducted using throat-swab testing records of pediatric and neonatal inpatients aged 0–14 years with clinically diagnosed lower respiratory tract infection from January 2021 to December 2025. After 7-day deduplication within the same child, 20,250 testing records were included.
analysis_en.methods: The study analyzed thirteen pathogen categories using period comparisons, interrupted time-series models, and multivariable logistic regression incorporating meteorological factors, air quality index, and school-term status.
analysis_en.main_results: Overall positivity was higher in the post-NPI period than in the NPI period (75.4% vs. 58.8%), and co-detection was also higher in the post-NPI period (15.2% vs. Pathogen-specific interrupted time-series analysis showed heterogeneous patterns: human adenovirus showed a robust immediate level decrease (−13.00 percentage points; 95% CI, −20.13 to −5.87; FDR-adjusted P = 0.005), whereas human rhinovirus showed a significant positive trend change after the January 2023 interruption (+1.07 percentage points per month; 95% CI, 0.63–1.50; FDR-adjusted P < 0.001), with a positive post-NPI slope (+0.64 percentage points per month).

title_zh: COVID-19相关非药物干预措施解除后儿科呼吸道病原体谱的生态重塑:一项5年中断时间序列研究
source_body_en: Background COVID-19-related non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) disrupted the circulation of many respiratory pathogens. After these measures were lifted, pediatric respiratory pathogen activity may have changed in pathogen-specific ways. However, laboratory-based evidence using continuous multi-year data, interrupted time-series analysis, and contextual factors such as meteorology, air quality, and school calendars remains limited. Methods We conducted a single-center retrospective laboratory study of pediatric and neonatal inpatients aged 0–14 years with clinically diagnosed lower respiratory tract infection from January 2021 to December 2025. After 7-day deduplication within the same child, 20,250 throat-swab testing records were included. The NPI period was January 2021–December 2022, and the post-NPI period was January 2023–December 2025. Thirteen pathogen categories were analyzed using period comparisons, interrupted time-series models, and multivariable logistic regression incorporating meteorological factors, air quality index, and school-term status. Results Overall positivity was higher in the post-NPI period than in the NPI period (75.4% vs. 58.8%), and co-detection was also higher in the post-NPI period (15.2% vs. Pathogen-specific interrupted time-series analysis showed heterogeneous patterns: human adenovirus showed a robust immediate level decrease (−13.00 percentage points; 95% CI, −20.13 to −5.87; FDR-adjusted P = 0.005), whereas human rhinovirus showed a significant positive trend change after the January 2023 interruption (+1.07 percentage points per month; 95% CI, 0.63–1.50; FDR-adjusted P < 0.001), with a positive post-NPI slope (+0.64 percentage points per month). Higher temperature was associated with lower positivity of human respiratory syncytial virus, influenza A H1N1 (2009) virus, and influenza B virus, but higher positivity of human parainfluenza virus and human bocavirus. School-term status was associated with higher human rhinovirus positivity (aOR, 1.84; 95% CI, 1.34–2.52; FDR-adjusted P = 0.002). Conclusion The NPI and post-NPI periods showed distinct and heterogeneous temporal patterns in pediatric respiratory pathogen detection. These findings support integrated hospital-based laboratory surveillance centered on pathogen-specific temporal trends and interpreted alongside demographic, multi-pathogen, environmental, school-calendar, and longer-term temporal context.

title: Engineering human endogenous retrovirus-K for improving immunogenicity and broad cancer targeting
abstract: Abstract Background HERV-K (HML-2) is the most studied transcriptionally active endogenous retrovirus in human cancers, yet immune tolerance and incomplete mechanistic understanding have impeded its clinical use as an immunotherapy target. We hypothesized that rational engineering of the HERV-K envelope putative immunosuppressive domain (ISD) could improve immunogenicity. Methods We performed a mutational screen across the ISD region, evaluated NF-κB activation and then analyzed antigen expression in human monocyte-derived dendritic cells (moDCs) using flow cytometry, RNA-seq, and TEM. Human PBMCs were expanded with HERV-K–transduced moDCs to assess T cell priming and expansion ex vivo. Conclusions These results show that the rational redesign of the HERV-K ISD generates a potent immunogen capable of expanding human T cells and mediating mechanistically relevant anti-tumor immunity. We propose that HERV-K-ISDmut antigens represent a promising platform for cancer immunotherapy which should be explored in future clinical trials.

The research is motivated by the fact that HERV-K is the most studied transcriptionally active endogenous retrovirus in human cancers, yet its clinical application has been hindered by immune tolerance and incomplete understanding of its mechanisms. abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 HERV-K(HML-2)是人类癌症中最常研究的转录活跃的内源性逆转录病毒,但免疫耐受和对机制理解的不完整性阻碍了其作为免疫治疗靶点的临床应用。我们假设通过理性设计HERV-K包膜的潜在免疫抑制域(ISD)可以提高其免疫原性。方法 我们在ISD区域进行了突变筛选,评估了NF-κB激活情况,并利用流式细胞术、RNA-seq和TEM分析了人单核细胞来源树突状细胞(moDCs)中的抗原表达。通过HERV-K转导的moDCs扩增人外周血单核细胞(PBMCs),以评估T细胞的体外激活和扩增。使用腺病毒和LNP-mRNA 媒介在小鼠、HERV-K转基因小鼠和恒河猴中测试免疫原性。在小鼠中评估了HERV-K表达的转移性肾癌肿瘤模型的抗肿瘤效果。结果 将HERV-K包膜ISD改造为Q525A(ISDmut)增强了人树突状细胞中NF-κB激活、抗原表达以及与抗原呈递和细胞死亡相关的基因表达通路,同时保留了病毒样颗粒的组装。HERV-K-ISDmut转导的人树突状细胞能够扩增识别HLA匹配且HERV-K表达的肿瘤的CD4+和CD8+ T细胞,表明人体内的T细胞可以被体外扩增。在体内,编码HERV-K-ISDmut的mRNA和腺病毒媒介在小鼠中引发了强烈的免疫应答反应,打破了HERV-K转基因小鼠的耐受性,并在恒河猴中诱导了体液免疫反应。在小鼠中,腺病毒载体递送的HERV-K-ISDmut免疫进一步提高了HERV-K表达的肾癌肿瘤模型中的生存率,并且受益于抗PD-1治疗。结论 这些结果表明,对HERV-K ISD的理性改造产生了一种强效的免疫原,能够扩增人类T细胞并介导与机制相关的抗肿瘤免疫。我们提出HERV-K-ISDmut抗原代表了一种有前景的癌症免疫治疗平台,应在未来的临床试验中进一步探索。

title: Distinct kinetics and mechanisms of microbial inactivation of enteric virus revealed by capsid and genome integrity
abstract: Enteric viruses are important contaminants of surface waters and a significant burden on public health. In aquatic ecosystems, the stability of these pathogens is differentially impacted by abiotic and biotic stressors, which can exert inactivating effects. Here, we investigated the fate of two enteroviruses, echovirus 11 (E11) and coxsackievirus B5 (CVB5), and one adenovirus, human adenovirus 2 (HAdV2), in lakewater and explored the mechanisms underlying their microbial inactivation. By combining infectivity assays, genome quantification, and capsid integrity analysis, we characterized virus-specific inactivation kinetics and mechanisms and examined the relationship between infectivity loss and capsid structural integrity. We observed rapid, intermediate, and negligible decay for HAdV2, E11, and CVB5, respectively, and confirmed that microbial proteases contribute to their inactivation. In addition, we revealed that loss of capsid structural integrity drives E11 inactivation, but not HAdV2 inactivation. Genome decay did not consistently correlate with loss of infectivity, highlighting the limitations of genome-based detection for assessing the presence of infectious viruses. These findings provide new insights into the mechanisms governing virus inactivation in aquatic environments and emphasize the importance of understanding viral fate when interpreting molecular detection data to assess virus-associated microbial risks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 肠道病毒是地表水的重要污染物,对公共卫生构成重大负担。本研究旨在了解这些病毒在水生环境中的微生物灭活机制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究调查了两种肠道病毒,即埃可病毒11型(E11)和柯萨奇病毒B5型(CVB5),以及一种腺病毒人腺病毒 2型(HAdV2)在湖水中的命运。研究重点在于表征病毒特异性失活动力学及机制。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究结合感染力测定、基因组定量分析和衣壳完整性检测,以评估病毒特异性灭活的动力学和机制。这些方法用于考察感染力丧失与衣壳结构完整性之间的关系。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究观察到HAdV2、E11和CVB5分别表现出快速、中等和几乎无衰减的灭活趋势。研究确认了微生物蛋白酶对其灭活的贡献。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,衣壳结构完整性丧失驱动了E11的灭活,但并未驱动HAdV2的灭活。这突显了不同病毒微生物灭活机制的差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为理解水生环境中病毒灭活的机制提供了新的见解,并强调了在解释分子检测数据以评估病毒相关微生物风险时,理解病毒命运的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究突显了基于基因组的检测方法在评估感染性病毒存在方面的局限性,因为基因组的衰减与感染力丧失之间没有一致的相关性。由于研究结果仅基于摘要,证据强度中等。

By combining infectivity assays, genome quantification, and capsid integrity analysis, we characterized virus-specific inactivation kinetics and mechanisms and examined the relationship between infectivity loss and capsid structural integrity. We observed rapid, intermediate, and negligible decay for HAdV2, E11, and CVB5, respectively, and confirmed that microbial proteases contribute to their inactivation. abstract_zh: 肠道病毒是地表水中的重要污染物,对公共卫生构成重大负担。在水生生态系统中,这些病原体的稳定性受到不同的非生物和生物胁迫因素的影响,这些因素可能产生灭活作用。在这里,我们研究了两种肠道病毒——肠病毒11型(E11)和柯萨奇病毒B5型(CVB5),以及一种腺病毒人腺病毒 2(HAdV2)在湖水中的命运,并探讨了其微生物灭活的机制。通过结合感染力测定、基因组定量分析和衣壳完整性检测,我们描述了病毒特异性灭活动力学和机制,并研究了感染力丧失与衣壳结构完整性之间的关系。我们观察到HAdV2、E11和CVB5分别表现出快速、中等和几乎无衰减的灭活趋势,并证实微生物蛋白酶对其灭活起重要作用。此外,我们还发现衣壳结构完整性的丧失驱动了E11的灭活,但并未导致HAdV2的灭活。基因组的衰减与感染力的丧失之间没有一致的相关性,这突显了基于基因组检测评估传染性病毒存在的局限性。这些发现为理解水生环境中病毒灭活的机制提供了新的见解,并强调了在解释分子检测数据以评估病毒相关微生物风险时,理解病毒命运的重要性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 肠道病毒是地表水的重要污染物,对公共卫生构成重大负担。本研究旨在了解这些病毒在水生环境中的微生物灭活机制。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究调查了两种肠道病毒,即埃可病毒11型(E11)和柯萨奇病毒B5型(CVB5),以及一种腺病毒人腺病毒 2型(HAdV2)在湖水中的命运。研究重点在于表征病毒特异性失活动力学及机制。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究结合感染力测定、基因组定量分析和衣壳完整性检测,以评估病毒特异性灭活的动力学和机制。这些方法用于考察感染力丧失与衣壳结构完整性之间的关系。
analysis_zh.main_results: 本研究观察到HAdV2、E11和CVB5分别表现出快速、中等和几乎无衰减的灭活趋势。研究确认了微生物蛋白酶对其灭活的贡献。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,衣壳结构完整性丧失驱动了E11的灭活,但并未驱动HAdV2的灭活。这突显了不同病毒微生物灭活机制的差异。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为理解水生环境中病毒灭活的机制提供了新的见解,并强调了在解释分子检测数据以评估病毒相关微生物风险时,理解病毒命运的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究突显了基于基因组的检测方法在评估感染性病毒存在方面的局限性,因为基因组的衰减与感染力丧失之间没有一致的相关性。由于研究结果仅基于摘要,证据强度中等。

title: Overview of Delivery Methods for Gene Editing
abstract: The clinical success of CRISPR-based interventions depends primarily on the efficient delivery of editing components into target cells. While base and prime editing have refined genomic precision, achieving therapeutic efficacy requires specialized vehicles that can navigate systemic circulation, escape endosomes, and ensure cell-specific entry. Delivery platforms are traditionally categorized into viral and nonviral systems. Viral vectors, namely adeno-associated vectors (AAV), lentiviral vectors, and adenoviral vectors, employ evolved mechanisms to achieve high transduction efficiency and predictable biodistribution, yet remain constrained by immunogenicity and the risk of insertional mutagenesis. In contrast, nonviral approaches, including synthetic nanoparticles and physical methods, offer superior scalability and transient expression profiles, reducing long-term genomic risks. Next-generation platforms such as virus-like particles (VLPs), engineered extracellular vesicles (EVs), and functionalized nanoparticles have emerged to bridge this gap. These hybrid systems synergize the entry efficiency of viral proteins with the low-immunogenicity profiles of synthetic carriers. Ultimately, the optimal delivery method is determined by the CRISPR cargo format and target cell characteristics, balancing safety, immunogenicity, and scalability. This chapter emphasizes that the strategic selection of a delivery vehicle must be harmonized with the specific cargo and the unique biological requirements of the target tissue to ensure therapeutic success.

Viral vectors, namely adeno-associated vectors (AAV), lentiviral vectors, and adenoviral vectors, employ evolved mechanisms to achieve high transduction efficiency and predictable biodistribution, yet remain constrained by immunogenicity and the risk of insertional mutagenesis. In contrast, nonviral approaches, including synthetic nanoparticles and physical methods, offer superior scalability and transient expression profiles, reducing long-term genomic risks. Next-generation platforms such as virus-like particles (VLPs), engineered extracellular vesicles (EVs), and functionalized nanoparticles have emerged to bridge this gap. These hybrid systems synergize the entry efficiency of viral proteins with the low-immunogenicity profiles of synthetic carriers. Ultimately, the optimal delivery method is determined by the CRISPR cargo format and target cell characteristics, balancing safety, immunogenicity, and scalability. This chapter emphasizes that the strategic selection of a delivery vehicle must be harmonized with the specific cargo and the unique biological requirements of the target tissue to ensure therapeutic success.

abstract_zh: 基于CRISPR的干预在临床上的成功主要取决于编辑成分高效递送至靶细胞。尽管碱基编辑和原位编辑提高了基因组的精确性,但实现治疗效果需要专门的载体,能够穿越全身循环、逃逸内体并确保细胞特异性进入。递送平台传统上被分为病毒和非病毒系统。病毒载体,即腺相关病毒载体(AAV)、慢病毒载体和腺病毒载体,利用进化机制实现高转导效率和可预测的生物分布,但受限于免疫原性和插入突变的风险。相比之下,非病毒方法,包括合成纳米颗粒和物理方法,提供了更优的可扩展性和短暂的表达谱,从而降低了长期基因组风险。下一代平台,如病毒样颗粒(VLPs)、工程化细胞外囊泡(EVs)和功能化纳米颗粒,已出现以弥合这一差距。这些混合系统结合了病毒蛋白的进入效率与合成载体的低免疫原性特征。最终,最佳的递送方法由CRISPR载荷格式和靶细胞特性决定,需在安全性、免疫原性和可扩展性之间取得平衡。本章强调,递送载体的战略选择必须与特定载荷及靶组织的独特生物学需求相协调,以确保治疗成功。

title: An oncolytic virus armed with fowl adenovirus fiber-modified recombinant TRAIL enhances tumor targeting and immunotherapy activity
abstract: Abstract Oncolytic viruses have emerged as a promising strategy in cancer immunotherapy and have been applied to the treatment of various tumors. We previously demonstrated that oncolytic adenoviruses engineered expressing tumor necrosis factor-related apoptosis-inducing ligand (TRAIL) could induce apoptosis in tumor cells and modulate immune responses in the tumor microenvironment. To enhance targeting capability and antitumor immunity, the full-length TRAIL is intended to be replaced with a soluble TRAIL (sTRAIL). However, the sTRAIL is limited by structural instability and hepatic accumulation. In this study, we performed an optimized design based on the previously developed, more stable sTRAIL (FA1FT) by fusing it with a knobless fiber motif derived from fowl adenovirus type 1. Through structural analysis and genetic engineering, we developed a novel recombinant sTRAIL protein (mut-FA1TLST) that exhibited reduced liver tropism and enhanced antitumor activity both in vitro and in vivo. Furthermore, we incorporated this optimized sTRAIL into a capsid-modified oncolytic adenovirus, which demonstrated improved tumor targeting ability and antitumor efficacy. The recombinant oncolytic virus expressing the sTRAIL also promoted activation of CD4+ T cells, CD8+ T cells and DCs in the tumor microenvironment, thereby eliciting antitumor immune response. Overall, this study provides a promising recombinant sTRAIL candidate for preclinical and clinical applications and presents a novel oncolytic virus with potential for in vivo tumor immunotherapy.

title: Production and Storage of High-Capacity Adenoviral Vectors for the Delivery of Advanced CRISPR Systems
abstract: Genome editing based on engineered CRISPR systems is advancing rapidly, with the field increasingly moving toward approaches that avoid the induction of mutagenic double-stranded DNA breaks (e.g., RNA-programmable base editing, prime editing, and donor DNA transposition). These nuclease-free strategies often rely on large or multi-component molecular assemblies that can include gene-sized donor DNA substrates. There is, nonetheless, a paucity of vehicles capable of delivering such large and complex genome-editing components effectively and, ideally, in defined stoichiometric ratios. High-capacity adenoviral vector particles (AdVPs) offer an attractive set of features to address these challenges, including robust cell transduction levels regardless of mitotic status, exceptional payload capacity (up to ~36 kb), strict chromosomal nonintegrating character, and the complete absence of viral coding sequences. Hence, AdVPs can serve as biological nanoparticles suitable for the evaluation and application of next-generation CRISPR technologies in physiologically relevant cellular contexts, regardless of the size and number of the attendant tools. Here, after summarizing the key characteristics of earlier- and latest-generation adenoviral vector platforms, we describe protocols for producing AdVPs, including vectors that deliver multiplexing, prime-editing, and orthogonal nuclease constructs. Finally, we highlight important considerations for designing AdVP production reagents and validate a storage buffer that preserves AdVP functionality after repeated freeze-thaw cycles.

title: Neuroimmune responses in the chicken brain during acute fowl adenovirus serotype 4 infection
abstract: Introduction Fowl adenovirus serotype 4 (FAdV-4) causes fatal hepatitis in chickens and has a substantial impact on the poultry industry. The virus primarily targets the liver in chickens. Although viral load in the brain has been previously reported, the association of acute FAdV-4 infection with brain immune response remains poorly characterized. Therefore, this study focuses on immune alterations in the brain during acute FAdV-4 infection. Methods Here, we investigated an increase in immune cell populations, along with the expression of barrier-related genes, to define the neuroimmune response during FAdV-4 infection. Results Our results demonstrated that there was an alteration in the immune cell population, characterized by an increased frequencies of activated monocytes/macrophages and T cell subsets in the brain from infected chickens. Additionally, the CD44 + CD8 + and γδ CD8 + were elevated among T cell subsets and accompanied by a surge in TNFA mRNA expression. The alteration was extended to the low expression of genes encoding tight-junction (TJ) proteins, such as TJP1, CLDN5, and OCLN , and a depletion in CLDN5 protein levels. This downregulation corresponded to the detection of FAdV-4 hexon DNA in the chicken brain homogenates from the infected group, suggesting a potential link between structural barrier alterations and viral presence. Discussion Together, these findings suggest acute FAdV-4 infection-associated neuroimmune alterations, mapping a distinct immunophenotypic and transcriptional landscape within the avian brain.

title: Canine Adenovirüs Enfeksiyonları
abstract: Canine adenovirüs (CAV), köpeklerde önemli enfeksiyonlara neden olan, zarfsız, çift sarmallı DNA genomuna sahip bir virüstür ve Adenoviridae ailesinin Mastadenovirus cinsine ait bir virüstür. Köpeklerde hastalık oluşturan 2 farklı tip bulunmaktadır: Canine adenovirüs tip 1 (CAV-1) ve Canine adenovirüs tip 2 (CAV-2). CAV-1, enfeksiyöz köpek hepatitinin etkeni olup karaciğer, böbrek, göz ve damar endotelinde ciddi lezyonlara yol açabilir. CAV-2 ise başlıca solunum sistemini etkileyerek enfeksiyöz trakeobronşitis (kennel cough) kompleksinin önemli viral etkenlerinden biri olarak kabul edilmektedir. Virüs, enfekte hayvanların sekresyon ve ekskresyonlarıyla çevreye yayılır ve doğrudan temas veya kontamine materyaller aracılığıyla bulaşır. Klinik belirtiler enfeksiyonun tipine ve şiddetine bağlı olarak ateş, depresyon, solunum sistemi semptomları, gastrointestinal bulgular ve bazı olgularda ölümle sonuçlanabilen sistemik hastalık şeklinde ortaya çıkabilir. Tanıda klinik ve epidemiyolojik verilerin yanı sıra virüs izolasyonu, serolojik yöntemler ve moleküler teknikler de kullanılmaktadır. Günümüzde yaygın aşılama programları sayesinde birçok ülkede hastalığın görülme sıklığı önemli ölçüde azalmış olsa da, özellikle aşısız popülasyonlarda ve barınak koşullarında enfeksiyonlar hâlen önemini korumaktadır. Bu nedenle canine adenovirüs enfeksiyonlarının epidemiyolojisinin, klinik özelliklerinin ve korunma stratejilerinin iyi anlaşılması köpek sağlığının korunması açısından büyük önem taşımaktadır. Canine adenovirus (CAV) is a non-enveloped, double-stranded DNA genome virus that causes significant infections in dogs and belongs to the genus Mastadenovirus of the family Adenoviridae. There are 2 types of canine adenovirus that cause disease in dogs: Canine adenovirus type 1 (CAV-1) and Canine adenovirus type 2 (CAV-2). CAV-1 is the causative agent of infectious canine hepatitis and can lead to severe lesions in the liver, kidneys, eyes, and vascular endothelium. CAV-2, on the other hand, primarily affects the respiratory system and is considered one of the primary viral agents of the infectious tracheobronchitis (kennel cough) complex. The virus is shed into the environment through the secretions and excretions of infected animals and is transmitted through direct contact or contaminated materials. Clinical signs, depending on the type and severity of the infection, can manifest as fever, depression, respiratory system symptoms, gastrointestinal findings, and systemic disease that can result in death in some cases. In diagnosis, along with clinical and epidemiological data, virus isolation, serological methods, and molecular techniques are also used. Today, thanks to widespread vaccination programs, the incidence of the disease has significantly decreased in many countries; however, infections remain significant, especially in unvaccinated populations and in shelter settings. Therefore, a good understanding of the epidemiology, clinical features, and prevention strategies for canine adenovirus infections is of great importance for protecting canine health.
